seo.title: Our Designs — Venom Guitars
seo.description: Explore Venom Guitars' series — Red Belly Black, Taipan, and fully custom builds. Australian hardwoods, resin art bodies, deadly tone.

s3.k1: Each one a weapon. Each one a work of art.
s3.k2: Browse our guitar series — or skip straight to commissioning a fully custom build. Australian timbers, boutique hardware, and setups that play themselves.

s4.k4: Named after Australia's most iconic serpent, the Red Belly Black series is our flagship — bold, dangerous, and impossible to ignore. The body is carved from premium Australian Blackwood, with a hand-poured resin art finish featuring the black and red colourways of its namesake.
s4.k5: Hot single-coil pickups deliver that crisp, biting Aussie tone. Whether you're playing blues, rock, or going full noise, this guitar cuts through like a black snake through long grass.
s4.k28: Price on application — each build is unique. Contact us for a quote.

s6.k4: The Taipan — Australia's most venomous land snake — demands a guitar that lives up to the name. This series is built for the heavy hitter. Mahogany body for deep, resonant warmth. Twin high-output humbuckers for serious bite.
s6.k5: We're currently prototyping the Taipan series — testing different Mahogany-Maple combinations, refining the neck profile, and dialing in the pickup wind for maximum aggression without muddiness.
s6.k6: If you want early access or want to commission a pre-production Taipan, reach out now.

s8.k4: Short. Wide. Devastating. The Death Adder series takes a radical approach — a short-scale, wide-body guitar optimised for low tunings and baritone playing. Named after Australia's deadliest ambush predator.
s8.k5: We're currently prototyping the Death Adder series, refining the short-scale build and dialing in the resin art. If you're interested in a baritone or short-scale commission in this direction, reach out now.
s8.k7: We want player input on the Death Adder. Tell us what you want — specs, playability, price point. The people who reach out now will shape what this guitar becomes.

s10.k4: Drawing from the sinister elegance of the Redback Spider, this series trades scales for silk — a distinctive red stripe etched across a glossy black burl top. The Australian redback carries potent neurotoxic venom and a reputation that precedes it; this guitar is built to do the same on stage.
s10.k5: We're currently prototyping the Red Back series. If you want early access or want to commission a pre-production build, reach out now.

s12.k4: One of the world's most dangerous spiders calls the Sydney region home — and the Funnel Web series is our tribute. A dark, aggressive build with etched web and fang motifs across a matte black top, aimed at players who want something genuinely unsettling in their hands.
s12.k5: We're currently prototyping the Funnel Web series. If you want early access or want to commission a pre-production build, reach out now.
s12.k7: We want player input on the Funnel Web. Tell us what you want — specs, playability, price point. The people who reach out now will shape what this guitar becomes.

s14.k4: If our series doesn't quite nail what you're after, we do fully custom builds from the ground up. You pick every spec — body shape, tonewoods, hardware, electronics, finish. We build it.
s14.k5: Custom builds take 8-16 weeks depending on complexity. We'll send you progress photos throughout the build. When it arrives, it will be the only guitar in the world exactly like it.
s14.k25: Bright, articulate highs. Dense and hard.
